rule: No lower row is implied by an upper row. Finite enumeration calibrates an implementation; it is not authority for an all-size claim. A PARENT_OWNED row may not be cited in any novelty statement.

obligations.statement: Finite object/relation space is well-formed: unique ids, incident atoms exist, registered types, non-negative weights and resources.
obligations.mutant: duplicate id / unknown incident atom / negative weight rejected

obligations.statement: Antichain profiles with ⊕ (alternative) and ⊗ (conjunctive) form a commutative idempotent semiring with 0 = ∅, 1 = {∅}.
obligations.parent: ATMS labels (de Kleer 1986); provenance semirings (Green et al. 2007)
obligations.limitation: exhaustive at n=3 (20 profiles, 400 pairs, 8000 triples)

obligations.statement: Three-valued liveness on warrant intervals (lower = exhibited, upper = possible) is an exact homomorphism from (⊕, ⊗) to Kleene strong (∨, ∧); certified profiles reduce to two-valued ℓ_R; refinement is monotone (UNKNOWN → LIVE|DEAD only).
obligations.limitation: exhaustive at n=3 (168 intervals, 225,792 homomorphism checks)

obligations.statement: Revocation of any required tail or of the edge disables conjunctive firing for every activation vector; with three-valued liveness the verdict is ENABLED/DISABLED/UNKNOWN.
The warranted navigation matrix is substochastic.
Gate-based exact-share revocation equals pruning with the original pre-revocation denominators (matrix level).
obligations.parent: PARENT_PRODUCT_OWNED: (JTMS/ATMS gate) ∘ spreading activation with frozen denominators

obligations.statement: Exact-share retraction propagates to the fixed point: (i) revoked atoms have zero activation, (ii) atoms outside Reach(dead) are exactly unchanged, (iii) activation is monotone non-increasing, (iv) reinstatement restores the pre-revocation vector exactly.
obligations.mutant: renormalising parent must differ; unapplied retraction is CANNOT_CHECK

obligations.statement: Prune–solve equivalence at the fixed point and at the reacting subgraph: Solve_warranted(K, R, q) = Solve_warranted(Prune_R(K), ∅, q) under identical normalisation.
obligations.limitation: requires the same denominator convention on both sides

obligations.statement: Restart navigation a ← α s + (1−α) Pᵀ a is an ℓ1 contraction with a unique fixed point; iteration converges geometrically.
obligations.limitation: float solver agreement checked against exact within frozen tolerance

obligations.statement: Reaction surprise is zero for an atom whose query activation equals its background activation; a universal hub has zero surprise under a query-independent seed.
obligations.parent: IDF / degree normalisation; Bayesian surprise (design choice, replaceable)
obligations.limitation: the surprise function is a registered design choice, not a theorem of optimality

obligations.statement: Two-direction hub theorem: a query touching hub and specific atom ranks the specific atom first by surprise while the hub is first by popularity; a hub-only query ranks the hub first by both.
obligations.proof: exact rational computation on the registered witness; contract §26

obligations.statement: Quotient navigation commutes with pushforward iff the partition is Kemeny–Snell lumpable.
A representation move is admissible only under navigation lumpability ∧ warrant measurability (identical three-valued liveness within each block under every registered revocation).
obligations.proof: conjunction of KS-T07 and the S4 measurability requirement; docs/spec/KSO_REPRESENTATION_ABSTRACTION_V1.md §3
obligations.mutant: lumpable-but-not-measurable and measurable-but-not-lumpable partitions both refused

obligations.statement: Every newly admitted live non-quarantined atom is incident to at least one live typed relation (semantic connectivity or quarantine).
obligations.mutant: isolated live atom rejected; quarantined isolated atom no-alarm
obligations.limitation: invariant by construction, not a novelty theorem

obligations.statement: The dependency impact cone is the least dependency-closed superset of the changed set; cycles are handled by the fixed point.
obligations.proof: monotone operator on a finite lattice; §13

obligations.statement: Reopening locality: after a revocation delta the forced reopening set is cone ∩ liveness-changed; cone members whose liveness is unchanged (alternative live warrant) need re-check only; activation outside Reach(dead) is exactly unchanged; unrelated evidence revocation is a no-op.
obligations.proof: KS-T09 + KS-T04b(ii); docs/spec/KSO_CORE_V1.md §6 and ORION-V2 theory note
obligations.parent: dependency-directed backtracking (Doyle 1979); ATMS label update; incremental computation
obligations.limitation: reopening = re-evaluation obligation, not automatic repair

obligations.statement: Translator invariance reduces to seed equality: equal seed vectors yield identical extraction.
obligations.proof: extraction is a function of (K, R, s_Q, α) by KS-T11a
obligations.limitation: KS-T10 (two independent codecs agree on s_Q) stays OPEN_M5

obligations.statement: The reacting subgraph is well-defined and unique; the prize-collecting optimiser is a distinct object whose optima may tie.
obligations.limitation: exact optimiser bounded (≤ 12 free atoms); greedy arm reports its approximation

obligations.statement: Lifecycle-safe consolidation: a macro can be maintained/reopened in work proportional to the affected dependency region — CLAUSE (theory batch 7 G5): holds for query sets Q ⊆ exports of the consolidated region (gain (k−1)[t∈Q] − 2|Q∩internals|); the unconditional form is refuted (k = 1, Q = {x1}: 1 → 3).
obligations.limitation: not proved at M1; summaries implement only the warrant/authority law (KS-T23)
obligations.clause: PROVED_WITH_CLAUSE (theory batch 7 G5): Q ⊆ exports; status kept in the registry vocabulary, the clause is the theorem

obligations.statement: No authority from abstraction: Λ(summary) = Λ_corr ⊗ ⊗ Λ(exported); LIVE(summary) ⇒ live support exists below; DEAD/UNKNOWN propagate by KS-T21; authority is the meet and scope the intersection; a summary answers a query family only under a registered sufficiency certificate, else REFINE_REQUIRED.
obligations.proof: KS-T21 applied to the summary warrant; docs/spec/KSO_REPRESENTATION_ABSTRACTION_V1.md §4

obligations.statement: Stem-cell growth invariant: the loop acquire → compose → revoke → reinstate preserves KS-S1…S7, keeps the genome digest unchanged, and reaches a fixed point when nothing new can be acquired.
obligations.proof: each operator enforces S1/S2 and meters (S7); labels of existing atoms untouched (S5); contract §32

obligations.statement: Feedback cannot warrant: a FEEDBACK-admitted atom carries the certified-zero interval and is never LIVE, hence never enables firing; an EXACT_CHECKER atom enters with exact warrant.

Navigation outcome is four-valued (FOUND / GAP_NOT_FOUND / OBSTRUCTION_WITNESSED / CANNOT_CHECK), exhaustive and exclusive; an obstruction is witnessed only when the ungated ceiling walker also fails; timeout alone is a gap; a zero budget is CANNOT_CHECK.
obligations.proof: case split on target ∈ V, target ∈ C°, target ∈ C^R; contract §29
obligations.mutant: zero budget; timeout is not obstruction

obligations.statement: Composition warrant is ⊗ (never ⊕); authority is the meet; scope the intersection — no amplification.
obligations.proof: contract §3 composition law; WLL-4 union-scope countermodel

obligations.statement: Navigation is not truth: with every warrant certified-zero and identical weights, no atom is LIVE, warranted extraction is empty, and no edge is enabled, while exploratory activation is unchanged.
obligations.proof: gates are functions of liveness only; docs/spec/KSO_NAVIGATION_REFERENCE_V1.md §7

obligations.statement: A conjunctive hyperrelation is not equivalent to its pairwise expansion (enabling and navigation differ); pairwise reading requires an explicit certificate.
A new object type can be registered without changing warrant/navigation code.
obligations.proof: registry is data; core code is type-agnostic
obligations.mutant: unregistered type is a typed rejection

obligations.statement: Every reference mechanic reports a non-compensatory resource vector; vectors are compared by Pareto dominance, never a scalar.

No single parent among eight owns label-gated activation with exact-share retraction; the KSO law equals the two-parent product (JTMS/ATMS gate ∘ frozen-denominator spreading activation) — PARENT_PRODUCT_OWNED.
obligations.proof: shown on the witness (freeze checker F7), inherited

obligations.statement: Old-vs-new equivalence: the canonical package reproduces the frozen reference on every registered witness (matrices, fixed points, navigate outcomes, retraction report, F-check outcomes) and on seeded random spaces.
obligations.limitation: documented tightening: COMPOSITION_WARRANT_MISMATCH is rejected at admission (KS-S2), which the reference F4 case 1 did not check
